images.alt:
🌱 The Fresh Harvest Bowl 🌱
A vibrant, flavor-packed bowl designed your way—choose from slow-roasted rotisserie chicken, crispy fried chicken, or a plant-based alternative for the perfect protein boost. Served over fluffy rice, this bowl is loaded with shaved carrots, radish, tinker bell peppers, green beans, pea shoots, broccoli, and delicate slices of snap and snow peas, creating a refreshing balance of crunch and natural sweetness. Every bite is light, bright, and bursting with garden-fresh flavor—a nourishing, energizing meal that satisfies! 🥕🥦🔥
